strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct every FangRidderXie2026 anchor: write the comparison in λ, or explicitly define the proposal index by λ=c s_W; cite Theorem 5 for the DR result and reserve Theorem 4 for estimated-propensity IPW.

Define the estimated influence map on all samples, for example by using a measurable ridge/generalized-inverse fallback and proving it agrees with \(\widehat H_c^{-1}\) with probability tending to one under uniform curvature.
To move beyond a careful field-level verified application, develop the c→0 or deteriorating-overlap regime with a named primitive exponent and a matched lower bound or strict rate comparison.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Fang comparator mapping and make the plug-in bootstrap objects total; then the conditional field-level uniform-in-preference inference kernel can advance to Stage 0.
